# Test workflow
To add your YouTube cookies to GitHub Secrets:

Go to your repository on GitHub
Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
Click “New repository secret”
Name: YOUTUBE_COOKIES
Value: Paste the entire contents of your Netscape format cookies file
Click “Add secret”
The workflow will automatically use it in the “Setup YouTube cookies” step (line 62-68), creating the ~/.cache/yt-dlp/youtube/cookies.txt file that yt-dlp reads.

Important: Make sure your cookies file is in valid Netscape format. Each line should look like:

.youtube.com TRUE / TRUE 1234567890 cookie_name cookie_value

If yt-dlp still has authentication issues, the cookies might be expired or incomplete. You may need to export fresh cookies that include authentication tokens. 
take a look at https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies
